# Libraries

The libraries being used are as follows:

Rqc: early quality evaluation

```{r}
lapply(c("Rqc", "stringr", "QuasR", 'fastqcr'), library, character.only = T)
```

# Non-R Tools

The following tools from conda and Docker are used. Sadly, running Python commands from within R is not ideal, so this pipeline will frequently require manually running commands in terminal. However, this script will generate the lines that are required for easy copy and paste.

Sequali is used to generate reports on raw data files.

ragatag is used to scaffold contigs together

funannotate is ran within a Docker container to prevent dependency conflicts.

# File Downloads and Declaration

Ensure the files being processed are accessible in your working directory. When working with data files, please ensure they are named in the format 'genusSpecies.fastq', and similarly for reference files, please name them in the format of 'genusSpecies_genomic.fna' from the default NCBI naming scheme. Alternatively, simply keep both the reads file and corresponding reference file named similarly to the above.

```{r}
pathway <- "data/raw_data"
references <- 'data/references'
```

# QC

Perform early quality-control of reads to ensure that they are usable for further processing. Done by checking read quality using Rqc charts and sequali reports.

## RQC

```{r}
#| echo: false
#Note that the files must be in fastq.gz format. As such, a loop will ensure all the files are in gzipped first
tryCatch({
  for(file in list.files(pathway)){
    if(!file.exists(paste0(file, ".gz"))){
      system2(command = 'gzip', args = c('-k', paste0(pathway, '/', file)), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
    }
  }
}, error = function(e){
  paste("gzipping failed: ", e$message)
}
)
```

```{r}
rqc_qc <- rqc(path = pathway, pattern = '.fastq.gz', openBrowser = FALSE, outdir = "outputs", workers = 6)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqcCycleQualityBoxPlot(rqc_qc)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqcCycleBaseCallsLinePlot(rqc_qc)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
rqcReadFrequencyPlot(rqc_qc)
```

```{r}
fastqc_reports <- fastqc(fq.dir = pathway)
qc_aggregate()
```

## Sequali

```{r}
#GENERATES COMMANDS. PLEASE RUN THESE COMMANDS IN THE APPROPRIATE CONDA ENVIRONMENT
dir.create('outputs/sequali_reports', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    print(paste0("sequali --outdir outputs/sequali_reports ", pathway, file))
  }
}
```

For reference, check the following values in the report generated by Sequali

- N50: 5,000bp+ is good for Oxford Nanopore

- Mean / median read length: 2,000bp+ is ideal

- Read length: peaks should be expected fragment size

- Q score: 10+, with 12 - 14 being ideal

# Preprocessing

Using QuasR, process the fastq files based on the data obtained above:

- Remove reads with more than 1 N

- Truncate bases from the end when quality decreases

- Remove patterns at the start of the read

- Remove reads that are too short

```{r}
#NOTE: Lpattern used here is an Oxford Nanopore barcode
fastq_files <- list.files(pathway, pattern = '.fastq.gz', full.names = TRUE)
trimmed_file_names <- paste0('outputs/trimmed_reads/trimmed_', basename(fastq_files))
output_file_names <- paste0('outputs/processed_reads/processed_', basename(fastq_files))
dir.create('outputs/trimmed_reads', showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create('outputs/processed_reads', showWarnings = FALSE)

#As preprocessReads breaks if it encounters a read with a equal to or less than value to truncate, two rounds of preprocessing is used. One is to reduce the sets to just reads of a minimum length of 40 with no Ns, and to remove one of the barcodes. The second is to remove the low-quality ends and the second barcode.

preprocessReads(fastq_files, trimmed_file_names, 
                minLength = 40,
                nBases = 1,
                Lpattern = 'ACGATAAATGCGAAAACTCTA',
                )
preprocessReads(trimmed_file_names, output_file_names,
                truncateEndBases = 4,
                Lpattern = 'ACGATAAATGCGAAAACACGT')
```

# Assembly

Using flye from a conda environment, assemble a genome

```{r}
#5 rounds of polishing will be used
polishing_rounds <- 5
dir.create('outputs/flye_outputs', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/flye_outputs/', file_name))
    print(paste0("flye --nano-hq ", pathway, '/', file, " --out-dir outputs/flye_outputs/", file_name, " --threads 8 --iterations ", polishing_rounds), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

Using medaka, perform additional rounds of polishing onto the files generated by flye

```{r}
dir.create('outputs/medaka', showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create('outputs/medaka/round1', showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create('outputs/medaka/round2', showWarnings = FALSE)

#Round 1 of medaka polishing
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/medaka/round1/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('medaka_consensus -i data/raw_data/', file, ' -d outputs/flye_outputs/', file_name, '/assembly.fasta -o outputs/medaka/round1/', file_name, ' -t 8'), quote = FALSE)
  }
}

#Round 2 of medaka polishing
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/medaka/round2/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('medaka_consensus -i data/raw_data/', file, ' -d outputs/medaka/round1/', file_name, '/consensus.fasta -o outputs/medaka/round2/', file_name, ' -t 8'), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## Scaffolding

Using ragtag, scaffold the contigs together

```{r}
dir.create('outputs/scaffolds', showWarnings = FALSE)

for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/scaffolds/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('ragtag.py scaffold ', references, '/', file_name, '_genomic.fna outputs/medaka/round2/', file_name, '/consensus.fasta -o outputs/scaffolds/', file_name), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

# Evaluation

Using busco and quast, evaluate the completeness of the assembly obtained.

With busco, ensure that the proper docker container is available to be used. Also ensure you are using the appropriate reference lineage under -l. The default used here is saccharomycetaceae_odb12.

Note that -f was used to force files to be overwritten. Please be careful with where you store files.

```{r}
#pichiaceae_odb12 database can also be considered for the current project
dir.create('outputs/busco', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/busco/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('docker run --rm -v \"$PWD\":/data -w /data ezlabgva/busco:v6.0.0_cv1 busco -i outputs/scaffolds/', file_name,'/ragtag.scaffold.fasta -o outputs/busco/', file_name, ' -l saccharomycetaceae_odb12 -m genome -c 8 -f'), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

\|\|\|Using quast, evaluate the quality of the assembly

```{r}
#MIGHT NOT RUN THIS? PROBABLY CAN'T WITHOUT GFF FILE
dir.create('outputs/quast', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/quast/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('docker run --rm -v \"$PWD\":/data -w /data quay.io/biocontainers/quast:5.3.0--py313pl5321h5ca1c30_2 quast.py outputs/medaka/round2/', file_name, '/consensus.fasta -r data/references/', file_name, '_genomic.fna -g data/GCF_000146045.2_R64_genomic.gff -o outputs/quast_output'), quote = FALSE)
  }
}

```

# Structural Annotation

Using funannotate, annotate the structure of both the assembly and the non-refseq reference files.

```{r}
# Define reusable variables
IMAGE <- "nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM <- "--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS <- 8
dir.create('outputs/funannotate', showWarnings = FALSE)

#Clean contigs
dir.create('outputs/funannotate/cleaned_contigs', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/funannotate/cleaned_contigs/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v \"$PWD\":/data -w /data ', PLATFORM,  ' ', IMAGE, ' funannotate clean -i outputs/medaka/round2/', file_name, '/consensus.fasta -o outputs/funannotate/cleaned_contigs/', file_name, '/assembly_clean.fasta'), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Sort contigs and standardize header names
dir.create('outputs/funannotate/sorted_contigs', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/funannotate/sorted_contigs/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v \"$PWD\":/data -w /data ', PLATFORM,  ' ', IMAGE, ' funannotate sort -i outputs/funannotate/cleaned_contigs/', file_name, '/assembly_clean.fasta -o outputs/funannotate/sorted_contigs/', file_name, '/assembly_sorted.fasta'), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Soft-mask repeated elements
dir.create('outputs/funannotate/masked_contigs', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/funannotate/masked_contigs/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v \"$PWD\":/data -w /data ', PLATFORM,  ' ', IMAGE, ' funannotate mask -i outputs/funannotate/sorted_contigs/', file_name, '/assembly_sorted.fasta -o outputs/funannotate/masked_contigs/', file_name, '/assembly_masked.fasta --cpus ', CPUS), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Predict gene models
#Please remember to include the specific strain used
dir.create('outputs/funannotate/predictions', showWarnings = FALSE)
for(file in list.files(pathway)){
  if(str_detect(file, ".gz$")){
    file_name <- str_remove(file, '.fastq.gz')
    dir.create(paste0('outputs/funannotate/predictions/', file_name), showWarnings = FALSE)
    print(paste0('docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v \"$PWD\":/data -w /data ', PLATFORM,  ' ', IMAGE, ' funannotate predict -i outputs/funannotate/masked_contigs/', file_name, '/assembly_masked.fasta -o outputs/funannotate/predictions/', file_name, ' -s ', file_name, ' --strain   --busco_db saccharomycetes --cpus ', CPUS), quote = FALSE)
  }
}
```
